body.name: Exact unlabeled nice-decomposition recurrence
body.construction: At an empty leaf initialize \((\varnothing,\varnothing,0)\) with value zero.  At an introduce-vertex node for \(v\), either insert \(v\) into one existing block of \(\alpha\) or create the new block \(\{v\}\), create \(\{v\}\) as a singleton block of \(\pi\), leave \(d\) unchanged, and require \(d+|\alpha|\le K\) after the update.  At an introduce-edge node for \(e=\{u,v\}\in E\), merge the two \(\pi\)-blocks exactly when \(u,v\) lie in the same \(\alpha\)-block; an edge in \(E_F\setminus E\) leaves \(\pi\) unchanged.  At a forget-vertex node for \(v\), let \(A\) and \(P\) be its \(\alpha\)- and \(\pi\)-blocks.  Reject if \(P=\{v\}\) but \(A\ne\{v\}\); otherwise delete \(v\), and increment \(d\) exactly when \(A=\{v\}\), in which case the entire active cluster closes.  At a join, require the same \(\alpha\) in both children, set \(\pi\) to the transitive closure of the union of the two child connectivity relations, set \(d=d_1+d_2\), and require \(d+|\alpha|\le K\).  At every node add exactly the rational local charge indexed by \(H_t\).  At the empty root accept exactly \((\varnothing,\varnothing,K)\).  Each table value \(D_t(q)\) is the minimum over these legal predecessors, and \(P_t(q)\) stores a deterministically tie-broken minimizing predecessor or predecessor pair.
